Class MenuRenderer

java.lang.Object
com.r3m.spaceshooter.core.MenuRenderer
public class MenuRenderer extends Object
MenuRenderer handles all non-gameplay screen rendering: main menu, instructions, controls, and game over screen. Extracted from GameController to keep GameController focused on game logic only — following the Single Responsibility Principle. GameController owns WHAT state to render. MenuRenderer owns HOW to render it.
